basic_details.job_title: JIPMER Project Technical Support – III Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Neurology at Jawaharlal Institute of Postgraduate Medical Education and Research (JIPMER), Puducherry, is hiring 2 Project Technical Support – III staff on contract for an ICMR-funded stroke telerehabilitation project, at a consolidated Rs. 33,600/- pm (Rs.28,000/- + 5600 [20% HRA]) for a likely one year. A graduate degree with three years' post-qualification experience, or postgraduation in a relevant field, is required. Applications must be emailed to [email protected] by 5 pm on 18 November 2026, and the written test and interview are on 30 November 2026.

important_dates.interview_date: 30 November 2026 (written test 10:00 AM; interview 3:00 PM onwards)

how_to_apply: Use the application format (REC-03) attached to the notice. Print it on A4 paper and fill it in Block Letters with a blue pen, with a recent passport size photo affixed (not stapled).
Add your CV and supporting documents, and scan everything into one PDF.
Write the name of the post applied for in the email subject line.
Make sure the email is sent by 5 pm on 18 November 2026.

Applications not in the prescribed format will not be processed or accepted. Anyone applying for two or more different posts must fill a separate form for each post and send each in a separate email. A valid email ID and mobile number are compulsory.

The application form also asks for a description of experience in up to 500 words, research experience or publications if any, whether the applicant is willing to travel to the field or other centres, and contact details of previous employers.
All certificates must be self-attested and attached in this order:
Proof of Identity (copy of Aadhaar card / Voter ID / Passport / Driving License)
Certificate in support of age (Tenth equivalent / High School Certificate)
Proof of prior research experience, if any
The form also asks for proof if the applicant is SC/ST/OBC, and for PDFs of proof of work for previous employment.

content_sections.heading: JIPMER Project Technical Support – III at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

rows.details: Jawaharlal Institute of Postgraduate Medical Education and Research (JIPMER)
Co-design and implementation of a multidisciplinary stroke telerehabilitation package at a tertiary care centre in South India: A Hybrid Type II effectiveness implementation quasi-experimental study
One year (extended up to three years based on satisfactory performance of the candidate)
Not exceeding 35 years (as on last date of receipt of applications)

content_sections.heading: About JIPMER
content_sections.text: JIPMER is a medical education and research institute at Dhanwantri Nagar, Puducherry. This vacancy is for a contract post in a research project funded by an external agency, ICMR. The project principal investigator is Dr. Saranya B Gomathy of the Department of Neurology.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Essential: Graduate degree in Occupational Therapy/ Physiotherapy (BOT/BPT) or Nursing (BSc Nursing), Sociology, Public Health or equivalent degree with three years of post-qualification experience or postgraduation in relevant field. Age: Not exceeding 35 years, as on the last date of receipt of applications. The notice does not list any age relaxation. Desirable: Experience in clinical research, stroke rehabilitation or telehealth related projects. Knowledge of telehealth and telerehabilitation guidelines and methods. Computer skills in MS Office, Excel, email and video-conferencing tools. Experience in using digital health platforms, mobile based applications and telehealth tools. Ability to converse in Tamil fluently. Proficiency in SPSS/STATA/R and data management software (Epicollect/REDCap). Qualification and experience should be in a relevant discipline/field and in a reputed institution/organization. The experience should have been gained after acquiring the essential qualification. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The consolidated remuneration is Rs. 33,600/- pm, made up of Rs.28,000/- plus 5600 [20% HRA]. The consolidated salary may vary from time to time, and no other allowance or facilities beyond it will be extended. The likely duration is one year, extended up to three years based on satisfactory performance of the candidate. The engagement may be extended or curtailed at the discretion of the Project Investigator.

content_sections.heading: JIPMER Project Technical Support – III Job Description
content_sections.text: Assist the Project Research Scientist in coordinating day to day project activities. Support screening, recruitment and enrolment of stroke survivors and caregivers. Assist in obtaining informed consent and maintaining participant records. Coordinate telerehabilitation sessions and follow-up visits. Assist in conducting baseline assessments and follow up. Support caregiver training and coordination with the multidisciplinary team. Monitor participant follow-ups and intervention activities. Assist in data entry, data management and preparation of project reports. Maintain bills, vouchers and other financial records and support project fund utilization. Perform other project related duties assigned by the Principal Investigator.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for JIPMER Project Technical Support – III
content_sections.text: Use the application format (REC-03) attached to the notice. Print it on A4 paper and fill it in Block Letters with a blue pen, with a recent passport size photo affixed (not stapled). Add your CV and supporting documents, and scan everything into one PDF. Name the PDF file "Candidate name_Post-name_year_application". Email the PDF to [email protected] . Write the name of the post applied for in the email subject line. Make sure the email is sent by 5 pm on 18 November 2026. Applications not in the prescribed format will not be processed or accepted. Anyone applying for two or more different posts must fill a separate form for each post and send each in a separate email. A valid email ID and mobile number are compulsory. The application form also asks for a description of experience in up to 500 words, research experience or publications if any, whether the applicant is willing to travel to the field or other centres, and contact details of previous employers. All certificates must be self-attested and attached in this order: Proof of Identity (copy of Aadhaar card / Voter ID / Passport / Driving License) Certificate in support of age (Tenth equivalent / High School Certificate) Degrees/Diplomas Experience certificates Proof of prior research experience, if any Any others, if relevant (specify) The form also asks for proof if the applicant is SC/ST/OBC, and for PDFs of proof of work for previous employment.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applicants will be shortlisted based on the details furnished in the application, CV and the documentary proof provided. The list of eligible candidates will also be displayed on the JIPMER website. After the application form is evaluated, the process is a written test followed by an interview. The final selection will be based on CV, application, and written test/interview. Written test topics: basic knowledge of stroke and post-stroke rehabilitation, principles of telerehabilitation and telehealth, research methodology, clinical research coordination, participant recruitment and informed consent, multidisciplinary rehabilitation, caregiver training, data collection and management, digital health platforms, implementation research, monitoring and evaluation, and basic statistical analysis. Only shortlisted candidates will be called for a written test and/or interview. The Project Investigator's decision will be final. If the number of applications is very large, more stringent criteria than those specified may be used to determine eligibility. Date: 30 November 2026 Written test: 10:00 AM Interview: 3:00 PM onwards, for candidates who qualify in the written test Venue: Seminar Room (Near Neurology Office), Department of Neurology, JIPMER Puducherry

faq.question: Q1. How many Project Technical Support – III posts are vacant at JIPMER?
faq.answer: The notice lists 2 posts of Project Technical Support – III, on contract in the Department of Neurology project funded by ICMR.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Complete applications must be emailed by 5 pm on 18 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification required?
faq.answer: A graduate degree in Occupational Therapy/ Physiotherapy (BOT/BPT) or Nursing (BSc Nursing), Sociology, Public Health or equivalent degree with three years of post-qualification experience, or postgraduation in relevant field.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age must not exceed 35 years, counted as on the last date of receipt of applications.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary?
faq.answer: The consolidated remuneration is Rs. 33,600/- pm (Rs.28,000/- + 5600 [20% HRA]).

faq.question: Q6. Is HRA paid on top of the Rs. 33,600 pay?
faq.answer: No. The Rs. 33,600 already includes 5600 as 20% HRA, and no other allowance or facilities beyond the consolidated salary will be extended.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Email the filled application form with CV and supporting documents, scanned in one PDF, to [email protected], with the post name in the subject line.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Applicants are shortlisted on their application, CV and documents, then take a written test and an interview. The final selection is based on CV, application and written test/interview.

faq.question: Q9. When are the written test and interview?
faq.answer: Both are on 30 November 2026: the written test at 10:00 AM, and the interview from 3:00 PM onwards for those who qualify in the written test.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent job, and is TA/DA paid for the interview?
faq.answer: It is a contract position for the duration of the project, likely one year and extendable up to three years, with no claim to a regular post. No TA/DA is paid for attending the interview.
